title: Cinnabar Crafting
description: Vanilla/survival friendly ways of obtaining cinnabar by crafting with sulfur block. Makes it a renewable block.
body:
> If this project helped you, please consider leaving some stars [on the Github](https://github.com/Derec-Mods)! 

[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/donate/kofi-singular-alt_vector.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/derexxd) 

## About

You can now craft the new cinnabar stone using sulfur and granite, inspired by [this Reddit thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/minecraftsuggestions/comments/1umnd6n/i_know_mojang_didnt_wanna_create_a_whole_new/) by 0v3rTh0ught u/Glorfindel77

Lightweight datapack adding crafting recipes for obtaining Cinnabar! This by default is nonrenewable and spawns in the new sulfur cave biome. 

![Crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1730ee9653eee70a14cddd6da803df455777828_0.webp)
